verdict.rationale: Trivy is an open-source CLI/binary distributed via package managers and Docker images, meaning the core scanning engine runs entirely on the user's own infrastructure with no mandatory SaaS dependency, satisfying the self-hosting expectation for an AI-native user who wants full control over the tool. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a self-hosted 'Trivy Server' mode/architecture for shared caching, and independent hands-on confirmation of air-gapped/offline self-hosted deployments.
